title: Adaptive catalyst discovery emerges from composable scientific intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2611.13536v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Catalysis underpins chemical manufacturing, yet knowledge for catalyst design remains dispersed across experimental observations, computational data and catalysis subdisciplines. To overcome this challenge, we present Composable Catalytic Intelligence (CatAI), a physics-grounded modular AI framework that learns 1.8 million structure-property relations and organizes them into 30 physicochemical encoders. This reusable intermediate layer enables task-specific models to guide catalyst discovery for targeted reactions and objectives. Across benchmark tasks, CatAI achieves a 7.8% lower task-averaged prediction error than the next-best models. In experimental validation, CatAI identified a new confined-passable pocket catalyst applicable in industrial homogeneous polymer synthesis with 9 times the activity of the commercial benchmark. In parallel, it guided autonomous closed-loop optimization of a highly active Cu-based geminal-atom photocatal

translated_title: 自适应催化剂发现源于可组合的科学智能
translated_abstract: 催化是化学制造的基础，然而催化剂设计的知识仍分散于实验观测、计算数据以及催化的各子学科之间。为克服这一挑战，我们提出了可组合催化智能，这是一个以物理为基础的模块化人工智能框架，它学习180万个结构-性能关系，并将它们组织成30个物理化学编码器。这一可复用的中间层使任务特定的模型能够针对目标反应和目标来指导催化剂发现。在多项基准任务中，CatAI的任务平均预测误差比次优模型降低了7.8%。在实验验证中，CatAI发现了一种新型受限可通过空腔催化剂，可应用于工业均相聚合物合成，其活性达到商业基准催化剂的9倍。同时，它还指导了一种高活性铜基孪原子光催化剂的自主闭环优化……
tldr: CatAI是一个物理驱动的模块化AI框架，通过学习180万个结构-性能关系并组织成30个可复用的物理化学编码器，在催化剂发现任务中预测误差降低7.8%，并在实验中发现活性达商业基准9倍的新型催化剂。
en_tdlr: CatAI is a physics-grounded modular AI framework that learns 1.8 million structure-property relations organized into 30 reusable physicochemical encoders, achieving 7.8% lower prediction error than next-best models and experimentally discovering a catalyst with 9 times the activity of the commercial benchmark.
